sources.title: xuan-liu/ARIES · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ARIES model weights ARIES predicts enzyme-conditioned reaction sites on substrate atoms using exact GROVER atom and directed-bond representations, ESM-C 6B residue representations, and a reaction-template representation. Source code, installation instructions, and the aries-inference command are available in the ARIES GitHub repository.
